notes.zh-CN: v0.14.0：虚拟追踪器与姿态采集、空间锚点、多语言界面；反馈改经加密中继发送，安装包不再携带任何邮箱账号。
notes.en: v0.14.0: virtual trackers and pose capture, space anchors, multilingual UI; feedback now goes through an encrypted relay, no mail account ships in the installer.
